description: This PHP source file defines the ConfigurationProvider class within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for the S3 UseArnRegion module. It provides various configuration provider functions to determine how AWS S3 client configurations are fetched, including environment variables, ini files, and fallback defaults. The class includes methods for creating default providers, environment variable-based providers, ini-file-based providers, and fallback options, with support for caching and composition of multiple providers.

classes.name: ConfigurationProvider
classes.description: Provides various static methods to create configuration providers for AWS S3 UseArnRegion configurations, including environment-based, ini-file-based, and fallback configurations. Supports method chaining, caching, and composing multiple providers into a single promise-based provider.

methods.name: defaultProvider
methods.description: Creates a default configuration provider that checks environment variables, shared config files, and fallback options, possibly with caching, to produce a configuration promise.

methods.name: env
methods.description: Returns a provider function that creates configuration based on environment variables.

methods.name: ini
methods.description: Returns a provider function that loads configuration from a specified ini file, with support for profiles.

methods.name: fallback
methods.description: Provides a fallback configuration with default options when other sources are unavailable.
